en-US.description: The Confluent CLI lets you manage your Confluent Cloud and Confluent Platform deployments, right from the terminal.
en-US.longDescription: The Confluent command-line interface (CLI), confluent, enables developers to manage both Confluent Cloud and Confluent Platform and is source-available under the Confluent Community License (for more details, check out the Announcing the Source Available Confluent CLI blog post). The Confluent CLI is feature-packed to help users go from learning Confluent to building automated workflows.
en-US.name: Confluent CLI
en-US.releaseNotes:
New Features
- Add confluent lightning query to run a SQL query on Lightning Tables and print the results as a table, JSON, or YAML

Bug Fixes
- Show VARIANT nodes of an unknown type as "" instead of "" in confluent flink shell results
- Fix confluent flink shell failing with "can't fetch results" and confluent flink statement create --wait returning early while a Confluent Platform statement is still starting
- Upgrade Go to 1.26.10 to distrust the compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate authorities (CVE-2026-111943) and fix other Go standard library vulnerabilities
